method: No HCX recall. Frozen answer hashes, resolver/selector trace, selected contexts, and the manually frozen gold evidence were compared.

failures.finding: The resolver correctly fixed active_subject=DB, but the selector returned no requirement for the indirect 30-day average-wage calculation question. The exact DB.benefit_determination gold chunk was available but never requested.

The explicit product code KR5127420045 was not retained as one active product in the current/change-possibility wording. The single-subject front end returned unresolved before selector, retrieval, or answer generation.
The exact period-cost table was supplied and cited. HCX compressed the requested columns to a 1-to-10-year range, omitting the required 2·3·5-year columns.
The resolved latter product and direct annual fee table were correct and cited. HCX named only the 총 보수·비용 item, omitting the requested 지급비율(연간, %) table identity.
Both DB requirements and their direct chunks were supplied. HCX retained 평균임금 and 계속근로기간 but omitted the decisive 퇴직 전 평균임금 30일분 detail.

front_end_nonsemantic_regression.finding: The selector added product.period_cost to the correct current-risk-grade and total-fee requirements. The answer did not use the extra context and remains semantically useful, but the extra requirement causes front-end precision to fall below the P46 gate.

conclusion: P46 is No-Go. Three substantive failures are genuine generation omissions with direct gold evidence already in context, but two structural false rejections and one selector precision regression remain. Fine-tuning must not start until those front-end failures are removed and revalidated on a new fresh E2E holdout.
